system.description:
MENTAL UTILITY WARDING
Tradition divinity
Cast 10 minutes (somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration until the target next completes a Full Rest or your next daily preparations

You bless the target's coming rest, quietening nightmares and strengthening the boundary around their sleeping mind.
While sleeping, the target gains a +2-status bonus to saving throws against Fear, possession, dream effects and other Mental effects originating outside their own mind.
Mundane discomfort, ordinary nightmares and routine environmental noise cannot by themselves prevent the target from gaining the benefits of its rest. Actual danger, injury, hostile creatures and severe environmental conditions function normally.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Affect one additional target.
+2 PP: Increase the saving throw bonus by 1, maximum +4.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
